verdict: A Group Policy setting has disabled access to Windows Update. The client cannot scan or install updates until the policy is adjusted.
fix: Inspect `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU`: `NoAutoUpdate`, `DisableWindowsUpdateAccess`, `SetDisableUXWUAccess`. The `Remove access to use all Windows Update features` policy is the usual culprit. Adjust the offending GPO to allow MECM-managed update scans (set `Configure Automatic Updates` to `4 - Auto download and schedule the install` or disable the block entirely).
